sections.title: Service inquiries
paragraphs: Submitting a request does not establish an attorney-client relationship. Please do not include confidential documents or sensitive account information. The team will provide instructions if additional information is needed.
A request is not an appointment.

sections.title: Professional relationships
paragraphs: Before paid work begins, the proposed engagement will identify the responsible provider, the work included, and the fee.

sections.title: Events
paragraphs: A priority-list signup does not reserve a seat or guarantee admission.

For application-based events, a place is not confirmed until the required acceptance and payment steps are complete. For direct-registration events, a place is confirmed only after payment is verified.

sections.title: Additional work
paragraphs: Any additional implementation work has its own scope and requires a separate agreement.
Any proposed paid work will have a defined scope and fee before it begins.
